An '''XCiter''', also known as a '''gas conversion enabler''', was a component used in [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. [[Blaster gas/Legends|Blaster gas]] from the [[gas chamber]] was released into the XCiter via the [[Heter-Valve]] when the weapon's trigger was pulled. The [[Gas/Legends|gas]] molecules were then excited by the energy released from the blaster's [[Blaster power pack/Legends|power pack]]<ref name="CRFG" /> for hand weapons, or attached [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] for larger blasters.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> The excited gases then moved into the weapon's [[Actuating module/Legends|actuating module]].<ref name="CRFG" /> XCiters had a [[variable pressure adjustor]] that could regulate how much excited blaster gas entered the actuating module. Improper settings on the adjustor could cause the weapon to overload, misfire, or result in a loss of firepower over time.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
